blocks.text: Background. Why the current path is the wrong tool

Hank Morel owns a leftover that is easy to skip: bay-02.ridgeway.internal. I will ping once. After that the owner is late, not blocked. Unique to this file (44): refuse on three-word write-ups, lock is complaint, when, speed, change, then cause/correction. I will not hide a process change inside a 'quick align' on RDW-2888.
Makes a noise is not a write-up. When, how fast, and whether it changed yesterday is a write-up.

What a skeptical lead would try first on writeup.ridgeway.internal: the path Nina Soto actually has, not an empty-tote photo. Metric I will argue is a clean confirm, not a vanity units-per-hour. If we cannot show that path on shop.ridgeway.internal with the numbers already in this file, we do not have a cut. Jeilen Jones will not accept a hallway yes as that proof.
